mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO order_appointment_slots (order_id, slot_id, pet_id) VALUES
(#{item.orderId}, #{item.slotId}, #{item.petId})
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment_slots ast INNER JOIN order_appointment_slots AS oast ON oast.slot_id = ast.id SET ast.booked_count = GREATEST(ast.booked_count - 1, 0), ast.version = ast.version + 1 WHERE oast.order_id = #{orderId} AND ast.shop_id = #{shopId} AND ast.booked_count > 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FROM order_appointment_slots AS oas INNER JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oas.order_id WHERE oas.pet_id = #{petId} AND o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.order_type = 'booking' AND o.status = 'confirmed' AND COALESCE(o.appointment_end_time, o.appointment_time) > NOW()
